$comment: M37 spec 01, extended by M41 spec 05 — one entry per Herdr agent name. The TOP LEVEL is the SCREEN reader's line: the version Collie's pane grammar was last verified against, when, how, whether it has a block-grammar adapter (web/src/lib/harness/registry.ts), and the evidence that version is real. The optional `journal` block is the JOURNAL reader's own line (bridge/journal/), the source Chat draws from, with the same facts minus `adapter`: the block is present exactly where this build can read that agent's session log, so its presence IS the adapter fact. The two readers drift apart on one agent version — a vendor can change what it paints without changing what it writes — so one date cannot speak for both. `scripts/harness-drift.ts` prints a row per reader; `verified-versions.test.ts` pins every key the two registries map, plus pi and hermes (no block grammar), and that each `adapter` matches its registry. `how` is one of canary | live sweep | capture | unverified, on both halves.
